push.title: W 4-3 vs FMFC Academy | You: 8.8
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.8 against FMFC Academy. If football were a garden, you'd be the tomatoes.

THE GOOD
+ Completed passes 25, up from your usual 16. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 3 shots at FMFC Academy's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ Match rating 8.8, up from your usual 7.2. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Team wins are the best kind.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 3. Real quick: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Their humans averaged 43 completed passes; you had 25. That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.
- Shots on target: 67%. Keep pushing; 90%+ is within reach.

Backyard drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Before you go, BellyTb1: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Celebrate, then sleep. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs FMFC Academy | You: 8.3
push.body:
An 8.3 against FMFC Academy, buddskees. Good bones. Now let's hang some pictures on 'em.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes (up from your usual 17). That's what wanting the ball looks like.
+ A goal against FMFC Academy, your 2nd straight match scoring. You found the corner like it owed you rent.
+ 1 key pass. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ You and BellyTb1 play like you've known each other since kindergarten.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. For next time: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Here's the trick: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. Like riding a bike.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Don't sweat it, fix it.
- Their humans averaged 43 completed passes; you had 20. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

Practice plan: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Between you and me, buddskees: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

Next match, we go again. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs FMFC Academy | You: 8.1
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.1 against FMFC Academy. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against FMFC Academy. You finished it like the last bite of a good steak.
+ 1 key pass. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ Your passes to BellyTb1 had perfect weight and perfect timing.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- 73% passing (16 of 22). Training homework: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only. Trust the work.
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Key note: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. I've seen you do harder things.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Repeat after me: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.1 (best was BellyTb1's 8.8). That's the one I'd circle in red.

Fundamentals drill: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
